scope: Research-only consolidated index of verified AMOS Issue intakes; not a deployable strategy registry.

governance.original_vs_derived: Never relabel AE composition or Kelly retuning as a source theorem
promotion_requirements: Exact source provenance and ORIGINAL unit tests
AE_DERIVED module and assumptions separately tested
Immutable Raw Bid/Ask catalog and source/data/driver SHA
Native Nautilus fills >=1 and finite PF/EV/DD with evidence
governance.duplicate_key: paper.arxiv + source formula/implementation hash + input data SHA; no repeat on unchanged sample

baseline.native_engine: NautilusTrader==1.230.0 (existing branch declaration; not retested for this dictionary)
known_data_limitations: Approximately one day / 208501 Dukascopy XAUUSD Bid/Ask QuoteTicks in prior research
No multi-regime OOS or realistic impact calibration
baseline.unattended_cron: BLOCKED_DEFAULT_BRANCH until reviewed workflow merge; not active

records.title: Ratcheting/reset dividend control

original.novelty: Mixed singular/impulse/stopping ratcheting and reset with payout-rate bands; underlying methods are preexisting.

ae_derived.mapping: Research-only capital-extraction and reserve-reset controller; account equity is a proposed proxy for firm equity, not a source theorem.
failure_modes: Need actual withdrawal/equity history and reset friction
FX margin calls/jumps not captured by source diffusion

records.next_gate: Obtain multi-period account equity, withdrawals, financing and costs; verify ORIGINAL operator and boundaries before AE proxy testing.

records.title: Wiener-Hopf causal trading filter

original.novelty: Causal forecast-to-position optimizer with transient market-friction kernel; Wiener-Hopf factorization itself is foundational.

ae_derived.mapping: Shadow-only forecast-to-target-position filter upstream of the existing Risk Governor; source's beta>0 special case is NOT directly applicable to ordinary spot holding.
failure_modes: Need measured impact kernel and execution costs
One-day QuoteTicks cannot identify order-book impact
Stationarity, jumps and spot beta=0 require new derivation

records.next_gate: Calibrate causal impact/cost kernel from independent data and prove valid beta=0 formulation before native A/B.

records.title: Regime-switching equilibrium dividend barrier

original.novelty: Equilibrium dividend barriers with Markov regime switching, bankruptcy and non-exponential discounting.

ae_derived.mapping: Regime-dependent withdrawal thresholds on free surplus above ring-fenced reserves; NOT a direct FX entry signal.
failure_modes: Needs observable regimes and account cashflow histories
Regime-transition estimates and time-inconsistent preference weights not identified
Forced liquidation and price jumps violate diffusion assumptions

records.next_gate: Validate coupled ODE/free-boundary ORIGINAL separately; collect multi-regime equity, cashflow, margin and financing evidence.

records.title: Regime-weighted conformal VaR calibration

original.novelty: Sequential regime-weighted one-sided VaR calibration; conformal methods predate this work.

ae_derived.mapping: SHADOW-only loss-quantile pre-gate, Risk Governor remains authoritative; calibration coverage is NOT evidence of trading profitability.
failure_modes: Finite-sample validity under arbitrary nonstationarity is not guaranteed
Regime-feature lookahead and low effective sample size
One-day data cannot validate multi-regime tail coverage

records.next_gate: Obtain multi-regime OOS; test exact weighted quantile, ESS fallback, Kupiec/Christoffersen exceedance and cost-aware DD.

records.title: Queue-sensitive passive market impact

original.model: P_t=P_0+kappa_bar*integral_0^t xi(t-s)dD_s+R_t; queue-affine correction includes H_t+J_t (J_t is an anticipation term, not zero by assumption)
original.novelty: Queue-state passive liquidity correction and calibration on ES futures order-book messages; Hawkes/propagators are preexisting.

ae_derived.mapping: Candidate shadow market-impact estimator only after licensed exchange order-book events and execution calibration; not derivable from XAUUSD L1 quotes alone.
failure_modes: No real LOB messages or cancellations in existing QuoteTick catalog
ES venue model may not transfer to OTC XAUUSD

records.next_gate: Secure licensed LOB event data, identify J treatment, measure OOS predictive gain and real broker costs.

records.title: Finite-action diffusion control / action screening

original.novelty: Under restrictive convexity/terminal-shape conditions, lower convex hull screens actions and yields ordered feedback thresholds.

ae_derived.mapping: Research-only discrete lot/risk-action selector for a one-dimensional equity-buffer state, compared with rounded continuous sizing; NOT an exact theorem once switching costs are added.
failure_modes: Terminal-shape, convexity and uniform ellipticity assumptions may fail
Nonzero position switching costs require a different control model
FX jumps, nonlinear margin and multivariate risk invalidate direct theorem transfer

records.next_gate: Prove finite-action theorem assumptions and independent Bellman numerical test; add switching-cost state if needed.
